image_description: A close-up photograph of a small, slender snake with smooth, glossy scales being held in a human hand. The snake has a uniform pinkish-brown to reddish coloration on its dorsal side and appears to have a lighter, pale ventral side visible where the body curves. The head is small and barely distinct from the neck, consistent with burrowing snakes. The background is blurred green foliage.
